_about: Hero shots for the README (lane h1-hero). Run: node tools/hero_capture.mjs [--only id]. See docs/images/README.md.

shots.title: The live title menu
shots.note: Playwright screenshot of /index.html with no autostart and no ?shot=. Wall-time, not pixel-repeatable. The game itself uses docs/images/title-screen.jpg as the title backdrop (index.html:806), so that file is NOT replaced.

Michi at the torii as the lanterns kindle
The machiya lane in the rain, at cat height
River bank in morning light, Michi and Kuro, the pagoda over the trees

shots.title: Michi at the Moon Pool at night
The tea house interior, low sun through the shoji

shots.title: Luna, Mochi and Kuro
shots.note: review-sheet capture (tools/cat_preview.html), the real Cat API without the game's post-processing

shots.title: The meditation seat above the Kyoto basin, morning (the summit sky has no true dawn: 5.7-6.0 h reads as blue night, 6.4 h as bright day)
shots.note: tools/summit_preview.html, the real SummitManager; wall-time pollen and cloud drift

shots.title: Roof Road: Michi and Chidori on the ridge at dusk, pagoda on the skyline
shots.note: /kyoto-rooftops.html sandbox; hour is the sandbox phase 0..1. The sandbox has no ?cam=, so eval stops the run camera's update and places the camera 2.4 m behind and 0.9 m beside Michi, 1 m up (runView.camera)

shots.title: Roof Road finale: the five Okuribi fires
shots.note: skipFinale() lights all five fires; the result panel is hidden and the camera tilted down 0.055 rad with fov x0.92 to crop the top of the sky (the star sprites are square, recorded for z-final)

shots.title: Parts sheet: the stone lantern (toro) exploded into its eight named parts
shots.note: PARTS SHEET, labelled: a real kit instance (asset:toro) built in the running game, each named part lifted in height order; bottom to top kiso, sao, chudai, hibukuro, lamp, halo, kasa, hoju
